import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    n = data[0]
    t = data[1]
    times = data[2:2+n]
    times.sort()
    total = 0
    count = 0
    for time in times:
        if total + time > t:
            break
        total += time
        count += 1
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
